entries.en: Having carefully pored over Matoya's missive, Ardashir explains that the primals are the key to the anima's enlightenment. He asks that you relive your fiercest battles with these celestial beings─not on the battlefield, but within your mind. Linked as you are to the anima, he posits that it would be as if your aetherial companion experienced these epic battles firsthand. Heeding his request, you take a deep breath, still your mind, and think back to your first encounter with the godlike beings known as primals.

entries.en: You awake with a start, your heart still racing from your vivid recollections of your confrontations with Ifrit, Garuda, and Titan. Yet there is still much for you to share with the anima. You close your eyes once more and prepare to summon from the depths of your memory yet another harrowing battle with the primals.

entries.en: You open your eyes again for a short reprieve from reliving the more arduous experiences of your past. With the memories of combat still fresh in your mind, you check─perhaps out of habit─to be certain your garb is neither soaked nor singed from battle. Alas, there is no rest for the weary, for many tales of derring-do remain untold. Again you clear your mind, and summon forth a vision of strife and struggle against the unbridled fury of the primals.

entries.en: The ring of steel echoes in your ears as you stir back to consciousness. Though the confrontations have taken place entirely within your mind's eye, your muscles are strangely sore, your body stiff as if from great physical exertion. And yet, there is still one tale to tell─of three gods locked in perpetual conflict, and the brave soul that dared to bring them low.

entries.en: You return to your senses in a cold sweat, a sigh of relief escaping from your lips as you realize the battles were all in your mind. Though it was not in the flesh that you faced these encounters anew, your sharp and stirring memories of your great deeds will doubtless prove of great value to the anima. Having exhausted your repository of grueling memories of your confrontations with the primals, you seek out Ardashir, that together you might awaken the anima's newfound knowledge.

entries.en: Ardashir would proceed with the next stage of Matoya's plan: namely, to employ an enchantment to ingrain the anima's newly gained knowledge into the core of its being. There is, however, a rub─all the materials needed for the procedure are readily available save one─an ancient variety of enchanted ink said to be made only in the lands of Sharlayan. Knowing of no merchants who might deal in such exotic goods, Ardashir defers to your unequaled talent for procurement.

entries.en: Through means available only to one of your experience and expertise, you procure a bottle of archaic enchanted ink and deliver it to Ardashir. He follows Matoya's instructions to the letter, outlining an arcane circle for the spell and gently placing the anima weapon in its center. As your aether flows into the circle, you focus your thoughts on the anima, which soon manifests before you. Your hearts and minds are as one now, the anima acutely aware of your faith and aspirations for the journey to come. The deep attachment you feel toward the anima has cast away its fears, leaving only hope and an unshakable resolve. After myriad trials and tribulations, your aetherial companion has truly come into its own. Though you know not what the future may hold, you take comfort in knowing that whatever perils you may face, you will not face them alone. Indeed, your foes must now stand against the might of the anima.
entries.fr: Vous avez remis  à Ardashir, qui en a de son côté terminé avec les préparatifs du sort, aidé par Gerolt. Votre arme anima parachevée posée sur le symbole magique dessiné par le jeune savant, vous avez alors fait part à l'esprit synthétique de votre souhait le concernant. Grâce à l'expérience acquise en découvrant les Primordiaux à vos côtés et à la nature bienveillante de l'énergie éthérée que vous lui avez transmise, il s'est définitivement résolu à vous servir pour le reste de son existence. Les liens qui vous unissent ont ainsi été renforcés, et la lueur de cette intense complicité fait briller votre arme anima de mille feux.  de cette arme anima “lux” et  de votre fidèle complice, vous ne craignez plus rien ni personne !

entries.en: I have pored over Mistress Matoya's instructions─twenty times over, in fact─and I do believe I have settled on our next course of action. Allow me to elaborate.

entries.en: As she explains it, the primals are the key to developing the anima's sense of self. I will grant that the idea may seem far-fetched, but bear with me. As you are well aware, they are beings of aether─much like the anima─summoned forth using crystals, and driven by the faith of their followers.
entries.fr: D'après elle, la clef, ce sont les Primordiaux, ces êtres supérieurs invoqués par la force de la détermination des peuples qui les vénèrent. On peut dire qu'ils sont la cristallisation de la volonté de chacun de leurs fidèles. Mais quel rapport avec notre expérimentation, me direz-vous ?
entries.ja:
マトーヤ様は、蛮神が鍵になるとして記しておられました。
蛮神とは、召喚者の強い願いによって顕現する存在……
ある意味において、「想いの結晶」とさえ呼べるでしょう。

entries.en: But to what ends do their followers summon them so? How do they fight once made manifest? This is the knowledge I would have you share with the anima.

L'idée serait qu'il s'imprègne de la puissante résolution qui anime ces créatures lorsqu'elles combattent. Et pour cela, il faudrait que vous vous remémoriez vos affrontements épiques avec eux, arme anima en main.

entries.fr: Si votre souhait est que je vive librement, je serai ravi de vous exaucer et d'agir selon ma volonté. Et cette volonté... c'est justement de vous accompagner partout où vous irez pour vous servir !

entries.en: Your memories of battle were quite evocative. I feel as though I truly was there at your side, supporting your every blow against the primals. I have reflected deeply on all that I have seen. About the primals, and the dreams and desires that spurred them into action.
entries.fr: Je vous remercie d'avoir partagé avec moi ces souvenirs si intenses... Depuis que j'ai été témoin de vos combats avec les Primordiaux, je n'ai cessé de penser à ces êtres extraordinaires.

追想の旅……連れて行ってくれてありがとうございました。
……あれから、蛮神たちの強い「想い」について、
ずっと、考えていたのです。

entries.en: I realize now that even a simple wish─no matter how pure, how innocent─can at times be used to bring about calamity.
entries.fr: La pureté des pensées de leurs fidèles est la source de leur force incommensurable, et pourtant, elle est aussi à l'origine de tant de mort et de destruction...

純粋な願いによって生み出された力は、
時によっては、悲劇をもたらすものだと……。

entries.en: All I ever wished for was the strength to protect you. But am I not unlike the primals? An aetherial being seeking ever greater strength to fulfill my desires? If that power should come to cause you harm... The mere thought of it chilled me to my core.
entries.fr: Moi-même, je suis toujours en quête de puissance pour mieux servir . Et s'il m'arrivait un jour de me retourner contre vous ? Le simple fait de l'imaginer m'emplit de terreur...

私は、主を守るための力が欲しいと心から願っていました。
ただ、この願いがいずれ主を傷つけてしまったら……
そう思うと、自分の力が恐ろしくなったのです。

entries.en: The anima spirit has gained unyielding resolve, the weapon it inhabits now the pinnacle of martial perfection.
entries.fr: Vous êtes désormais en possession d'une arme anima lux ! Après avoir vécu de nouvelles expériences intenses à vos côtés et appris ce que vous souhaitiez pour lui, l'esprit synthétique en est persuadé : sa destinée est de vous accompagner partout où vous irez, pour vous servir et vous protéger ! Votre aventure commune ne fait que commencer...
